claim: A positive Staq startup floor plus shared pilot-time scaling improves reserved-family runtime prediction over matched frozen controls.
equation: rules.json models.reference: t_hat,k=A_k+B_k*x^p, SDK order Staq,Tket,BQSKIT; fixed negligible floors for Tket/BQSKIT.
interpretation: Effective overhead plus growing computational work explains the observed short/long-runtime curvature within these paired software experiments.
falsification: The pilot is a measured per-circuit calibration with real computational cost. Only successful matched cases and five held families are tested; no asymptotic-complexity, cross-hardware, quantum-physics or deployed-benefit claim is established. Metric reversal: mean family absolute runtime error is 5.1900 seconds for the reference versus 2.1163 seconds for proportional scaling. The admitted gain concerns relative log error, not uniformly improved error in seconds or measured scheduling time saved.
